ROOM_DETAIL.ADDRESS_c0775349-050b-4d57-a772-8d555537: 153/8 Quoc Huong Street, Thao Dien Ward, Thu Duc City (District 2)
ROOM_DETAIL.DESC_c0775349-050b-4d57-a772-8d55553727a: Nestled in a more peaceful and modern area, the Trần Não Branch offers a professional environment. It is ideal for individuals seeking a quieter stay with quick access to the emerging tech and business hubs in Thu Duc City.
ROOM_DETAIL.ADDRESS_2fa5d6dd-7b4d-45c6-aede-6924ffef: Nguyễn Cửu Vân, Bình Thạnh District
ROOM_DETAIL.DESC_2fa5d6dd-7b4d-45c6-aede-6924ffefca9: The Nguyễn Cửu Vân Branch offers a unique living experience in the vibrant Binh Thanh District. Its proximity to District 1 makes it a highly sought-after location.
ROOM_DETAIL.DESC_8568e0de-0fb4-40d2-98e9-70721ab363e: Experience urban living at its finest in the heart of District 10. The Tô Hiến Thành Branch provides convenient access to universities and shopping areas.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_INTRO: To ensure transparency, we follow a standardized financial and legal framework across all branches:
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_RENT_DESC: Clearly listed per bed or per full-room based on your selection.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_DEPOSIT_DESC: Calculated as (02 months' rent) × (Number of beds).
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_CONFIRM_DESC: Once a reservation is made, you have exactly 24 hours to upload your payment proof (receipt/screenshot) to your profile to secure your spot.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_REFUND_100: 100% Refund: Completion of the full contract term.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_REFUND_70: 70% Refund: Stays exceeding 06 months but ending before the contract term.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_REFUND_80: 80% Refund: Cancellations made after depositing but before signing the formal contract.
ROOM_DETAIL.TWIN_AMENITIES: Individual bed with premium mattress, desk and chair, personal wardrobe, private locker, dedicated power outlets, air conditioning, and organized shoe storage.
ROOM_DETAIL.QUAD_AMENITIES: Bunk beds with privacy curtains, premium mattress, individual study desks, secure lockers, air conditioning, and spacious shared areas for group activities.
ROOM_DETAIL.DINING_DESC: A clean and modern space with refrigerators, microwaves, and dining sets for communal meals.
ROOM_DETAIL.LIVING_DESC: A comfortable social zone for relaxing, meeting friends, or group study sessions.
ROOM_DETAIL.LAUNDRY_DESC: On-site modern washing and drying machines available for all residents.
ROOM_DETAIL.ADDRESS_FOOTER: 227 Nguyen Van Cu Street, Ward 4, District 5, HCMC.
